summary: Quantumoney.app cryptocurrency game platform requiring cross-domain user ID mapping between Quantumoney.app and QuantumoneyAR.app to enable unified profile synchronization across multiple canisters
architectural_notes: Cross-domain user mapping: Principal → internal UserID (UUID/hash) required for Quantumoney.app and QuantumoneyAR.app synchronization
UserID must be primary key for all data storage, not Principal
Canister ckmsk-taaaa-aaaah-atfca-cai: Game Logic/Profile/Progression (XP, QMY/ICP coins, captured monsters)
Canister nemlr-6aaaa-aaaan-q32la-cai: Governance/Treasury (bonus and rewards distribution)
Canister ippxc-5iaaa-aaaae-qgwqq-cai: Main Profile/Unified UserID (site ↔ app synchronization)
Canister x5shd-hqaaa-aaaap-qrdgq-cai: DAO/Game data warehouse (transaction history, player actions)
Canister i7nyb-2yaaa-aaaaj-qowiq-cai: Bridge/Integration (communication between additional canisters)
Canister lkawl-3qaaa-aaaac-qdsoq-cai: Extra canister/Complementary game data
Mapping table must store: Principal (domain A) → UserID, Principal (domain B) → same UserID
known_issues: Current system uses Principal directly as internal UserID, preventing real cross-domain synchronization
Different Principals generated by Internet Identity for Quantumoney.app vs QuantumoneyAR.app domains
Profile data not unified between site and application due to Principal-based identification

existing_features.title: Display Principal ID, internal UserID, and all active canister IDs with their functions on the Banco Central page. Show the following canisters with their descriptions: crjop-jyaaa-aaaah-atfaq-cai (Frontend/UI - page and interface control), ckmsk-taaaa-aaaah-atfca-cai (Game Logic/Profile/Progression - XP, QMY/ICP coins, captured monsters), nemlr-6aaaa-aaaan-q32la-cai (Governance/Treasury - bonus and rewards distribution), ippxc-5iaaa-aaaae-qgwqq-cai (Main Profile/Unified UserID - real site ↔ app synchronization), x5shd-hqaaa-aaaap-qrdgq-cai (DAO/Game Data Warehouse - transaction history, player actions), i7nyb-2yaaa-aaaaj-qowiq-cai (Bridge/Integration - communication between additional canisters), lkawl-3qaaa-aaaac-qdsoq-cai (Extra Canister/Supplementary Game Data). Present this information in a clear, organized, and readable format.

Ensure all profile data, progression, coins, and bonuses are accessible via the unified canister architecture listed in REQ-1. Confirm that no data depends on separate Principals and that the system uses the internal UserID for data storage and retrieval across all canisters.

new_feature_requests.summary: Display Principal ID, internal UserID, and all active canisters with detailed functions on Banco Central page
Implement unified canister architecture for site and QuantumoneyAR.app application
